purpose: Evaluate all supported car-based ticket markets from one coherent ordered-top3 probability object against timestamped observed decimal odds.
principle: Do not train separate sporting outcome models per ticket market. Derive every ticket-event probability from the same ordered top3 distribution, then compare each derived probability with its own market price.
candidate_rule: A ticket may be labeled SHADOW_POSITIVE_EV_CANDIDATE only when shadow_ev_per_unit > 0 under a probability object and market observation both frozen before result knowledge. This label is research evidence, not a real-money execution instruction.

market_specific_notes.wide: unordered pair both finishing within top3; overlapping events are expected

anti_hindsight: No odds replacement after result knowledge.
No probability/model/threshold changes after late odds are observed for that card.
No dropping losing tickets or adding winning tickets after outcome.
Missing odds remain missing; do not reconstruct from payout/result.
evaluation_order: probability quality first: log loss / Brier / calibration / temporal stability
then shadow market comparison on prespecified development data
then, only with separate governance clearance, bankroll/risk and real-money execution research
owner_direction_note: Owner stated intended eventual usage spans 3rentan, 3renhuku, 2shatan, 2shahuku and wide where expected value is favorable. This prespec translates that intent into a coherent shadow-research interface without narrowing to 3rentan.
